verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken structure. The 'AUTHOR EVENING' eyebrow has moved below the venue copy, and the beige circle now sits behind the headline and logo instead of behind the book. The FREE, SIGNED COPIES and Q&A pills are oversized, stacked vertically and set far below the CTA, so they compete with 'Reserve a Seat' and leave large dead gaps. A is slightly worse: its headline wraps onto three lines, leaving 'Hours' orphaned on its own line. B keeps the headline to two lines, but the date comes before the description and the eyebrow is still out of order.
